title: Which prices are whole thousands between two numbers?
description: Joseph's cycle shop sells cycles at whole-thousand prices. The video lists every price between two limits by finding the first and the last thousand.
teaching_notes: One idea: ones, tens and hundreds all zero means a whole number of thousands, so find the first and last thousand between the limits. Watch for a thousand just below the low limit.

source: Let Us Do (second set) 6, ones, tens and hundreds are 0
video_script.why: The child knows place value but has not yet listed numbers that have zero in their last three places.
video_script.substitution: Find the first thousand after the low limit and the last thousand before the high limit, then count up in thousands.
video_script.anchor: Joseph's cycle shop with prices in whole thousands of rupees
video_script.wrong_answer: forty-two thousand is the first one
video_script.wrong_move: Chintu says forty-two thousand is the first price because it is close to the low limit. It is smaller than forty-two thousand, seven hundred and fifty, so it is not between.

final_answer.spoken: from forty-three thousand to fifty-three thousand, one thousand at a time, eleven numbers

maths_rules: low limit 42,750 and high limit 53,500; the ones, tens and hundreds digits are all 0
a number with those three digits 0 is a whole number of thousands
slip: 42,000 < 42,750, so it is before the low limit
first thousand after 42,750 is 43,000; last thousand before 53,500 is 53,000
video_script.design: Exercise: whole thousands between two limits. Hint: zeros in the last three places. The cycle shop price tags stay as the anchor and the row of prices fills in.

narration: <bookmark mark='cmp'/>To check, look at the last three digits of every number.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>They must all be zero, and the number must stay between the two limits.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Is your first number above the low limit? Is your last number below the high limit?
